args.title: GameSession carries out its actions
args.description:
The application calls these methods on GameSession by exactly these names and keyword arguments. Each one changes the object as described.
- Field `status` holds exactly one of: "ready" (new game with no reveal yet; no mines placed and the timer not started); "in_progress" (after the first reveal and until the game is won, lost or abandoned; the timer is running); "won" (terminal: every safe cell has been revealed without revealing a mine); "lost" (terminal: a mine was revealed; all mines are exposed on screen); "abandoned" (terminal: the player ended the game early; no win or loss result)
- Field `cells[].state` holds exactly one of: "hidden" (the cell is covered and unflagged; it can be revealed or flagged); "revealed" (terminal for the cell: the cell is open and shows its adjacent_mine_count or blank); "flagged" (the player has marked the cell as a suspected mine; it cannot be revealed until unflagged)
- A refusal raises `ActionNotAllowedError` when the action is refused by the rules: revealing a flagged or revealed cell, flagging a revealed cell, any reveal or flag after the game is won, lost or abandoned, or abandoning a game that is not ready or in_progress; no cell state or timer changes
- A refusal raises `CellOutOfBoundsError` when row or column lies outside the board's rows and columns
- A refusal raises `InvalidDifficultyError` when start_new_game is given a difficulty whose rows, columns or mine_count do not match the preset for that difficulty
args.given_when_then: Given a GameSession in a state where the action is allowed (arrange that by setting its fields). When a GameSession is created with only its required fields and nothing is called on it Then status is ready, flag_count is 0, elapsed_seconds is 0, started_at and ended_at are null, rows, columns and mine_count are set from the chosen difficulty, and cells holds rows times columns records each with row and column set to its position, state hidden, has_mine false and adjacent_mine_count 0; no mines are placed until the first reveal. When `start_new_game(difficulty_id, rows, columns, mine_count)` is called with valid values Then Replaces the board with a new hidden board for the chosen difficulty: status becomes ready, every cell is hidden with no mine placed, flag_count and elapsed_seconds become 0, and started_at and ended_at are cleared. Allowed from any status, including in_progress, won, lost and abandoned; rows, columns and mine_count must match the chosen difficulty, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `reveal_cell(row, column)` is called with valid values Then Reveals the hidden, unflagged cell at row and column. On the first reveal of a ready session, mines are placed at random avoiding that cell, adjacent_mine_count is computed for every cell, status becomes in_progress and started_at is recorded. Revealing a mine sets status to lost and records ended_at; revealing a zero-count cell also reveals its neighbours repeatedly through connected zeros, stopping at numbered cells and leaving flagged cells flagged; when every safe cell is revealed status becomes won and ended_at is recorded. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress on a hidden unflagged cell, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `toggle_flag(row, column)` is called with valid values Then Toggles the flag on the cell at row and column: a hidden cell becomes flagged and flag_count rises by one, and a flagged cell becomes hidden and flag_count falls by one. It reveals nothing and does not start the timer. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress on a hidden or flagged cell, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `abandon_game()` is called with valid values Then Ends the current game with no result: status becomes abandoned, ended_at is recorded and elapsed_seconds stops at its current value. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress; the player then starts a new board at the same difficulty, and the object's fields show it afterwards. One test function per method.

actions.name: start_new_game
actions.description: Replaces the board with a new hidden board for the chosen difficulty: status becomes ready, every cell is hidden with no mine placed, flag_count and elapsed_seconds become 0, and started_at and ended_at are cleared. Allowed from any status, including in_progress, won, lost and abandoned; rows, columns and mine_count must match the chosen difficulty.

actions.name: reveal_cell
actions.description: Reveals the hidden, unflagged cell at row and column. On the first reveal of a ready session, mines are placed at random avoiding that cell, adjacent_mine_count is computed for every cell, status becomes in_progress and started_at is recorded. Revealing a mine sets status to lost and records ended_at; revealing a zero-count cell also reveals its neighbours repeatedly through connected zeros, stopping at numbered cells and leaving flagged cells flagged; when every safe cell is revealed status becomes won and ended_at is recorded. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress on a hidden unflagged cell.

actions.name: toggle_flag
actions.description: Toggles the flag on the cell at row and column: a hidden cell becomes flagged and flag_count rises by one, and a flagged cell becomes hidden and flag_count falls by one. It reveals nothing and does not start the timer. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress on a hidden or flagged cell.

actions.name: abandon_game
actions.description: Ends the current game with no result: status becomes abandoned, ended_at is recorded and elapsed_seconds stops at its current value. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress; the player then starts a new board at the same difficulty.

deck.title: Beginner difficulty preset
deck.description: The Beginner preset fixes the board at 9 rows by 9 columns with 10 mines.
deck.given_when_then: Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Beginner Then the new game board has 9 rows, 9 columns and 10 mines

deck.title: Intermediate difficulty preset
deck.description: The Intermediate preset fixes the board at 16 rows by 16 columns with 40 mines.
deck.given_when_then: Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Intermediate Then the new game board has 16 rows, 16 columns and 40 mines

deck.title: Expert difficulty preset
deck.description: The Expert preset fixes the board at 30 columns by 16 rows with 99 mines.
deck.given_when_then: Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Expert Then the new game board has 16 rows, 30 columns and 99 mines

deck.title: Board size and mine count fixed for the session
deck.description: The difficulty fixes rows, columns and mine count for the whole game session. No action changes them.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game session is in progress at Expert difficulty When any board action is attempted Then the session rows, columns and mine count remain 16, 30 and 99

deck.title: New session starts in Ready state
deck.description: A newly created game session has no reveal yet, so it is in the Ready state with zero elapsed time.
deck.given_when_then: Given the player has chosen a difficulty When a new game is started Then the session status is ready and elapsed_seconds is 0

deck.title: Mines placed after first reveal
deck.description: Mines are not placed when the game starts. They are placed at random on the first reveal, and that reveal moves the session to In progress.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state with no mines placed When the player reveals a hidden cell for the first time Then mines are placed at random and the session status becomes in-progress

deck.title: First revealed cell is never a mine
deck.description: The cell revealed first is excluded from mine placement, so the first reveal can never trigger a loss.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals cell (r, c) first Then cell (r, c) has has_mine false

deck.title: Exact mine count placed
deck.description: Exactly the difficulty's mine count is placed on the board, on distinct cells.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session with mine_count M is placed after the first reveal Then exactly M cells have has_mine true

deck.title: Adjacency count of a safe cell
deck.description: A safe cell's adjacent_mine_count equals the number of mines among its eight neighbours.
deck.given_when_then: Given a safe cell with exactly K mines among its eight neighbours When mines are placed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is K, where 0 <= K <= 8

deck.title: Edge and corner cells count only existing neighbours
deck.description: For edge and corner cells, only neighbours that exist on the board are counted.
deck.given_when_then: Given a corner cell with 2 neighbours that are mines and 1 neighbour that is safe When adjacency is computed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is 2

deck.title: Zero count displays blank
deck.description: A safe cell with an adjacency count of zero is shown as blank rather than as the number 0.
deck.given_when_then: Given a revealed safe cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 When the board is displayed Then the cell is shown blank

deck.title: Reveal a hidden unflagged cell
deck.description: The player may reveal a hidden cell that is not flagged. The cell becomes revealed.
deck.given_when_then: Given a hidden unflagged cell in a session in progress When the player reveals the cell Then the cell state becomes revealed

deck.title: Flagged cell cannot be revealed
deck.description: A flagged cell must be unflagged before it can be revealed. A reveal on a flagged cell is ignored.
deck.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell Then the cell state remains flagged and nothing else changes

deck.title: Revealed cell cannot be revealed again
deck.description: Revealed is a terminal cell state. Revealing an already revealed cell is ignored.
deck.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell again Then the cell state remains revealed and the timer is unaffected

deck.title: Revealing a mine loses the game
deck.description: Revealing a mine ends the session as lost and stops the timer.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in progress and a hidden unflagged cell with has_mine true When the player reveals the cell Then the session status becomes lost and ended_at is recorded

deck.title: Zero-count reveal spreads to neighbours
deck.description: Revealing a safe cell with adjacency count zero also reveals all of its neighbours.
deck.given_when_then: Given a hidden unflagged safe cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 When the player reveals the cell Then all eight neighbours that exist become revealed

deck.title: Spread repeats through connected zeros and stops at numbers
deck.description: The spread continues through every connected zero-count cell. Numbered cells are revealed but do not spread further.
deck.given_when_then: Given a connected region of zero-count cells bordered by numbered cells When a zero-count cell in the region is revealed Then every cell in the region and its bordering numbered cells are revealed, and the numbered cells do not reveal their own neighbours

deck.title: Spread skips flagged cells
deck.description: A flagged cell cannot be revealed, so the spread leaves flagged cells hidden.
deck.given_when_then: Given a zero-count cell next to a flagged cell When the zero-count cell is revealed Then the flagged cell remains flagged

deck.title: Toggle a flag on a hidden cell
deck.description: The player toggles a flag on a hidden cell. Flagging changes hidden to flagged and unflagging changes flagged back to hidden.
deck.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell When the player toggles the flag Then the cell state becomes flagged, and toggling again returns the cell state to hidden

deck.title: Revealed cell cannot be flagged
deck.description: Flagging applies only to hidden cells. A flag action on a revealed cell is ignored.
deck.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell When the player toggles a flag on the cell Then the cell state remains revealed and the flag count is unchanged

deck.title: Flags do not reveal cells
deck.description: Placing a flag changes only the flagged cell and reveals nothing else.
deck.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell next to a zero-count cell When the player flags the hidden cell Then no other cell changes state

deck.title: Flagging before first reveal keeps session in Ready
deck.description: Flags may be placed while the session is Ready. A flag does not start the timer or move the session to In progress.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player flags a hidden cell Then the session status remains ready and elapsed_seconds stays 0

deck.title: Win when every safe cell is revealed
deck.description: The game is won when all safe cells are revealed. Mines remain hidden or flagged and do not block the win.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in progress where the last hidden safe cell is revealed When the reveal completes Then the session status becomes won and ended_at is recorded

deck.title: Win does not require flags
deck.description: A win depends only on revealed safe cells. Flags are not checked.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in progress where all safe cells are revealed and no mine cell is flagged When the last safe cell is revealed Then the session status becomes won

deck.title: Loss exposes all mines
deck.description: When the game is lost, every mine on the board is exposed to the player.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session that has just been lost When the board is finalised Then every cell with has_mine true is exposed to the player

deck.title: Loss display of mines and wrong flags
deck.description: On a loss, mines show as black dots and wrongly placed flags are marked.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session that is lost When the board is displayed Then mine cells show black dots and flagged cells without a mine show a wrong-flag marker

deck.title: Abandon a game at any time
deck.description: The player may abandon an unfinished game at any time to start a new board at the same difficulty. An abandoned game has no result.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready or in progress When the player abandons the game Then the session status becomes abandoned with no win or loss result and a new board is created at the same difficulty

deck.title: Timer starts at first reveal
deck.description: The elapsed timer starts when the first cell is revealed, not when the game is created or when a flag is placed.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals the first cell Then started_at is recorded and the timer begins counting

deck.title: Timer shows whole seconds
deck.description: The timer displays elapsed time as whole seconds.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session in progress for 75.6 seconds When the timer is displayed Then it shows 75

deck.title: Timer stops on win or loss
deck.description: The timer stops when the game is won or lost and does not advance afterwards.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session that has just been won or lost with elapsed_seconds 120 When time passes Then elapsed_seconds remains 120

deck.title: New game returns to Ready
deck.description: Starting a new game resets all cells to hidden, clears mines and flags, resets the timer and returns the session to Ready.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session that is won, lost or abandoned When the player starts a new game Then the status is ready, all cells are hidden, flag_count is 0 and elapsed_seconds is 0

deck.title: Session status transitions
deck.description: The session moves Ready to In progress on first reveal, then to Won or Lost. Won and Lost are terminal, and only a new game returns the session to Ready.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session that is won or lost When any action other than starting a new game is attempted Then the status remains won or lost

deck.title: Cell state transitions
deck.description: A cell moves Hidden to Revealed (terminal), and between Hidden and Flagged. A flagged cell cannot move directly to Revealed.
deck.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When a reveal is attempted Then the cell does not move to revealed, and given a revealed cell When any flag action is attempted Then the cell does not move to flagged

deck.title: Mine counter equals mines minus flags
deck.description: The mine counter shown to the player is the mine count minus the number of flags placed.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session with 10 mines and 3 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows 7

deck.title: Mine counter may go negative
deck.description: The mine counter is not clamped. It goes negative when the player places more flags than there are mines.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session with 10 mines and 12 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows -2

deck.title: Board actions after game end are ignored
deck.description: After a game is won, lost or abandoned, reveal and flag actions are ignored. They change no cell state and do not affect the timer.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session that is won or lost When the player reveals or flags any cell Then no cell state changes and elapsed_seconds is unchanged

deck.title: Input controls for reveal and flag
deck.description: Click or tap reveals a cell. Right-click or long-press toggles a flag.
deck.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell on the board When the player clicks or taps the cell Then a reveal is requested, and when the player right-clicks or long-presses the cell Then a flag toggle is requested

deck.title: Board tile appearance
deck.description: Hidden tiles look like grey raised tiles. Revealed tiles are flat light grey with numbers coloured as in classic Minesweeper: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red, 4 dark blue.
deck.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell and a revealed cell with count 2 When the board is displayed Then the hidden cell is a grey raised tile and the revealed cell is flat light grey with its number in green

deck.title: Flag marker appearance
deck.description: Flagged cells show a red flag.
deck.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When the board is displayed Then the cell shows a red flag marker

deck.title: Top bar layout
deck.description: The top bar shows the mine counter on the left, the status button in the centre and the timer on the right.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game session is displayed When the top bar is rendered Then the mine counter is at the left, the status button in the centre and the timer at the right

deck.title: Status button face reflects game status
deck.description: The status button shows a smiley face during play, a loss face when the game is lost and a win face when the game is won.
deck.given_when_then: Given a session that is in progress When the status button is displayed Then it shows the smiley face, and given a session that is lost Then it shows the loss face

deck.title: Single player persona only
deck.description: The interface offers only the player role. No other roles appear.
deck.given_when_then: Given the game interface is open When the player views the screen Then no other user roles or role-specific controls are shown

SPEC-ACT-GAMESESSION.test_source:
import pytest

from src.domain.game_session import GameSession


BEGINNER_MINES = [(8, c) for c in range(9)] + [(7, 8)]  # 10 mines, all far from (0, 0)


def _index(session):
    return {(cell["row"], cell["column"]): cell for cell in session.cells}


def _neighbours(row, column, rows, columns):
    result = []
    for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
        for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
            if (dr, dc) == (0, 0):
                continue
            r, c = row + dr, column + dc
            if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < columns:
                result.append((r, c))
    return result


def _place_mines(session, positions):
    """Set has_mine on the existing cells and recompute adjacent_mine_count."""
    index = _index(session)
    mine_set = set(positions)
    for (r, c), cell in index.items():
        cell["has_mine"] = (r, c) in mine_set
    for (r, c), cell in index.items():
        cell["adjacent_mine_count"] = sum(
            1 for nb in _neighbours(r, c, session.rows, session.columns) if nb in mine_set
        )


def _states(session):
    return {(cell["row"], cell["column"]): cell["state"] for cell in session.cells}


def test_constructor_creates_ready_hidden_board():
    # Given: a session created with only its required fields and nothing called on it
    session = GameSession(id="s1", difficulty_id="beginner", rows=9, columns=9, mine_count=10)

    # When: nothing is called (construction only)

    # Then: a new session starts in the "ready" status
    assert session.status == "ready"
    # Then: no flags have been placed, so flag_count is 0
    assert session.flag_count == 0
    # Then: the timer has not run, so elapsed_seconds is 0
    assert session.elapsed_seconds == 0
    # Then: no timer start was recorded, so started_at is null
    assert session.started_at is None
    # Then: no game has ended, so ended_at is null
    assert session.ended_at is None
    # Then: rows, columns and mine_count come straight from the 9x9 beginner preset
    assert session.rows == 9
    assert session.columns == 9
    assert session.mine_count == 10
    # Then: 9 * 9 = 81 cell records exist, one per position
    assert len(session.cells) == 81
    # Then: the records cover exactly the positions 0..8 by 0..8, each once
    positions = {(cell["row"], cell["column"]) for cell in session.cells}
    assert positions == {(r, c) for r in range(9) for c in range(9)}
    for cell in session.cells:
        # Then: each cell is hidden, since nothing has been revealed or flagged
        assert cell["state"] == "hidden"
        # Then: no mine is placed until the first reveal
        assert cell["has_mine"] is False
        # Then: no adjacency is computed until mines are placed
        assert cell["adjacent_mine_count"] == 0


def test_start_new_game_replaces_board_with_fresh_hidden_expert_board():
    # Given: a won expert game with a timer and a recorded end, one revealed cell and one mine
    session = GameSession(id="s1", difficulty_id="expert", rows=16, columns=30, mine_count=99)
    session.status = "won"
    session.elapsed_seconds = 120
    session.started_at = "2025-01-01T10:00:00"
    session.ended_at = "2025-01-01T10:02:00"
    session.flag_count = 0
    _index(session)[(0, 0)]["state"] = "revealed"
    _place_mines(session, [(5, 5)])

    # Given: a second identical game, used for the refused call
    refused = GameSession(id="s2", difficulty_id="expert", rows=16, columns=30, mine_count=99)
    refused.status = "won"
    refused.elapsed_seconds = 120
    refused.started_at = "2025-01-01T10:00:00"
    refused.ended_at = "2025-01-01T10:02:00"
    _index(refused)[(0, 0)]["state"] = "revealed"
    _place_mines(refused, [(5, 5)])

    # When: a start with mine_count 98, which does not match the expert preset
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        refused.start_new_game(difficulty_id="expert", rows=16, columns=30, mine_count=98)

    # Then: the refusal is an InvalidDifficultyError
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "InvalidDifficultyError"
    # Then: the refused game keeps its won status
    assert refused.status == "won"

    # When: the valid expert start, which matches the preset 16 x 30 with 99 mines
    session.start_new_game(difficulty_id="expert", rows=16, columns=30, mine_count=99)

    # Then: the status becomes ready
    assert session.status == "ready"
    # Then: flag_count and elapsed_seconds are reset to 0
    assert session.flag_count == 0
    assert session.elapsed_seconds == 0
    # Then: started_at and ended_at are cleared
    assert session.started_at is None
    assert session.ended_at is None
    # Then: the object's fields show the expert preset
    assert session.rows == 16
    assert session.columns == 30
    assert session.mine_count == 99
    # Then: the board has 16 * 30 = 480 cells
    assert len(session.cells) == 480
    for cell in session.cells:
        # Then: every cell is hidden, including the one that was revealed before
        assert cell["state"] == "hidden"
        # Then: no mine is placed on the new board
        assert cell["has_mine"] is False


def test_reveal_cell_refuses_flagged_cell_then_places_mines_on_first_safe_reveal():
    # Given: a ready 9x9 beginner session where cell (0, 0) is flagged (so flag_count is 1)
    session = GameSession(id="s1", difficulty_id="beginner", rows=9, columns=9, mine_count=10)
    _index(session)[(0, 0)]["state"] = "flagged"
    session.flag_count = 1

    # When: the player reveals the flagged cell (0, 0)
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        session.reveal_cell(row=0, column=0)

    # Then: the refusal is an ActionNotAllowedError
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "ActionNotAllowedError"
    # Then: the cell stays flagged
    assert _index(session)[(0, 0)]["state"] == "flagged"
    # Then: the session stays ready and the flag count is unchanged
    assert session.status == "ready"
    assert session.flag_count == 1
    # Then: no mines are placed, because the refused reveal was not a first reveal
    assert all(cell["has_mine"] is False for cell in session.cells)
    # Then: the timer has not started
    assert session.started_at is None

    # When: the player reveals the hidden, unflagged cell (4, 4), the first reveal
    session.reveal_cell(row=4, column=4)

    # Then: the session status becomes in_progress
    assert session.status == "in_progress"
    # Then: the start time is recorded (a value, not null)
    assert session.started_at is not None
    # Then: the game has not ended
    assert session.ended_at is None
    # Then: cell (4, 4) is now revealed
    assert _index(session)[(4, 4)]["state"] == "revealed"
    # Then: the first revealed cell is never a mine
    assert _index(session)[(4, 4)]["has_mine"] is False
    # Then: exactly mine_count (10) cells carry a mine
    assert sum(1 for cell in session.cells if cell["has_mine"]) == 10
    # Then: the flag on (0, 0) is still there, since flags are left alone
    assert _index(session)[(0, 0)]["state"] == "flagged"
    # Then: the flag count is unchanged by the reveal
    assert session.flag_count == 1
    # Then: each cell's adjacent_mine_count equals the number of mine neighbours it has
    index = _index(session)
    for (r, c), cell in index.items():
        expected = sum(
            1 for nb in _neighbours(r, c, 9, 9) if index[nb]["has_mine"]
        )
        assert cell["adjacent_mine_count"] == expected


def test_toggle_flag_refuses_revealed_cell_then_flags_and_unflags_hidden_cell():
    # Given: an in-progress 9x9 beginner game with 10 mines in row 8 and at (7, 8)
    session = GameSession(id="s1", difficulty_id="beginner", rows=9, columns=9, mine_count=10)
    session.status = "in_progress"
    session.elapsed_seconds = 30
    session.started_at = "2025-01-01T10:00:00"
    _place_mines(session, BEGINNER_MINES)
    # Given: cell (0, 1) is revealed, which is the refused case
    _index(session)[(0, 1)]["state"] = "revealed"

    # When: the player flags the revealed cell (0, 1)
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        session.toggle_flag(row=0, column=1)

    # Then: the refusal is an ActionNotAllowedError
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "ActionNotAllowedError"
    # Then: the revealed cell stays revealed
    assert _index(session)[(0, 1)]["state"] == "revealed"
    # Then: the flag count is unchanged
    assert session.flag_count == 0

    # Given: a snapshot of every cell state before the accepted toggle
    before = _states(session)

    # When: the player flags the hidden cell (0, 0)
    session.toggle_flag(row=0, column=0)

    # Then: cell (0, 0) becomes flagged
    assert _index(session)[(0, 0)]["state"] == "flagged"
    # Then: flag_count rises by one
    assert session.flag_count == 1
    # Then: no other cell changes state, since flags never reveal
    after = _states(session)
    for pos, state in before.items():
        if pos != (0, 0):
            assert after[pos] == state
    # Then: the status stays in_progress and the timer is untouched
    assert session.status == "in_progress"
    assert session.elapsed_seconds == 30
    assert session.started_at == "2025-01-01T10:00:00"

    # When: the player toggles the flag on (0, 0) again
    session.toggle_flag(row=0, column=0)

    # Then: the cell returns to hidden
    assert _index(session)[(0, 0)]["state"] == "hidden"
    # Then: flag_count falls back to 0
    assert session.flag_count == 0


def test_abandon_game_refuses_won_game_then_abandons_in_progress_game():
    # Given: an in-progress 9x9 beginner game, elapsed 75 seconds, started at a fixed time
    session = GameSession(id="s1", difficulty_id="beginner", rows=9, columns=9, mine_count=10)
    session.status = "in_progress"
    session.elapsed_seconds = 75
    session.started_at = "2025-01-01T10:00:00"
    _place_mines(session, BEGINNER_MINES)

    # Given: an identical game that is already won, used for the refused call
    refused = GameSession(id="s2", difficulty_id="beginner", rows=9, columns=9, mine_count=10)
    refused.status = "won"
    refused.elapsed_seconds = 75
    refused.started_at = "2025-01-01T10:00:00"
    _place_mines(refused, BEGINNER_MINES)

    # When: the player abandons the won game
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        refused.abandon_game()

    # Then: the refusal is an ActionNotAllowedError
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "ActionNotAllowedError"
    # Then: the won game keeps its status
    assert refused.status == "won"
    # Then: no end is recorded and the timer is unchanged
    assert refused.ended_at is None
    assert refused.elapsed_seconds == 75

    # When: the player abandons the in-progress game
    session.abandon_game()

    # Then: the status becomes abandoned, with no win or loss result
    assert session.status == "abandoned"
    # Then: ended_at is recorded (a value, not null)
    assert session.ended_at is not None
    # Then: elapsed_seconds stops at its current value of 75
    assert session.elapsed_seconds == 75
    # Then: the recorded start time is unchanged
    assert session.started_at == "2025-01-01T10:00:00"
